title: 第1300章 帝法击杀第四神将第1299章 一枪一个禁忌之王无敌神枪圣皇
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
虚空中，第四神将独自一人站在神枪圣皇的对面。
他的身体在微微颤抖，那张原本威严的脸上此刻满是狰狞与恐惧。
“你......你到底是什么怪物！”
第四神将的声音中满是颤抖，每一个字都透着绝望。
神枪圣皇没有回答，只是缓缓抬起了手中的长枪。
枪尖直指第四神将的眉心。
“轮到你了。”
第四神将的身体猛然一僵，一股前所未有的恐惧涌上心头。
他会死！
他真的会死！
这个念头在他的脑海中疯狂回荡，让他浑身都在剧烈颤抖！
可下一秒，第四神将的脸上却露出了一抹疯狂的笑容。
“哈哈哈哈哈哈！”
他仰天大笑，笑声中满是癫狂与不甘。
“杀我？你杀得了我吗！”
“神枪圣皇！同为八纪元之王巅峰！你比我强！这我承认！”
“可你能杀得了我吗！”
“八纪元之王巅峰，天难葬，地难灭！”
“就算是九重天极巅的无上存在，没有掌控帝法之前，也杀不了我！”
“最多就是将我打爆！将我封印！可我有无数种手段可以重生！”

“你想彻底杀死我？痴心妄想！”
他的声音中满是癫狂，每一个字都透着一种近乎疯狂的自信。
这是八纪元之王巅峰的底气！
这是活了无尽纪元积累下来的底蕴！
他可以被打败，但绝不会被杀死！
远古战场上，那些观战的禁忌强者们听到这番话，眼中也闪过了一丝认同。
确实。
八纪元之王巅峰的存在，生命力太强了！
他们的神魂与本源已经与天地大道融为一体，只要大道不灭，他们便几乎不死不灭！
想要彻底杀死一尊八纪元之王巅峰，太难了！
就算是九纪元的无上存在出手，也几乎不可能做到！
除非........
除非掌控帝法！
而神枪圣皇虽然强，可毕竟只是八纪元，更加没有掌控帝法。
没有帝法，就斩不断八纪元之王巅峰与天地大道之间的联系！
就不可能彻底杀死第四神将！
天庭阵营后方，那些附庸势力之主们，眼中也闪过了一丝希望。
只要第四神将不死，天庭就不算彻底输！
神枪圣皇却只是静静地看着第四神将，那双平静如水的眼眸中没有半分波澜。
等到第四神将的笑声落下，他才缓缓开口。
content_en:
In the void, the fourth god general stood alone opposite the Holy Spear Emperor.
His body was trembling slightly, and his originally majestic face was now full of ferocity and fear.
"You...what kind of monster are you!"
The fourth divine general's voice was full of trembling, and every word was filled with despair.
The Divine Spear Emperor did not answer, but slowly raised the spear in his hand.
The tip of the spear was pointed directly at the forehead of the fourth divine general.
"It's your turn."
The fourth divine general's body stiffened suddenly, and an unprecedented fear surged into his heart.
He will die!
He will really die!
This thought echoed crazily in his mind, making his whole body tremble violently!
But the next second, a crazy smile appeared on the fourth divine general's face.
"Hahahahahaha!"
He looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter full of madness and unwillingness.
"Kill me? Can you kill me!"
"The Divine Spear Emperor! We are both the pinnacle kings of the eighth era! You are better than me! I admit it!"
"But can you kill me!"
"The King of the Eighth Age is at his peak. Heaven cannot bury him, nor earth can destroy him!"
"Even the supreme being at the top of the Nine Heavens cannot kill me before he controls the imperial law!"
"The most you can do is to blow me up! Seal me! But I have countless ways to be reborn!"
"You want to kill me completely? Wishful thinking!"
His voice was full of madness, and every word revealed an almost crazy confidence.
This is the confidence of the King of the Eighth Age at his peak!
This is the foundation accumulated from living for endless eras!
He can be defeated, but never killed!
On the ancient battlefield, those taboo experts who were watching the battle heard these words, and a flash of recognition flashed in their eyes.
really.
The existence of the peak king of the eighth era has too strong vitality!
Their souls and origins have been integrated with the great road of heaven and earth. As long as the great road remains, they will be almost immortal!
It is too difficult to completely kill a peak king of the eighth era!
Even if the supreme being of the ninth era takes action, it is almost impossible to do it!
Unless...
Unless you control the imperial law!
Although the Holy Spear Emperor is strong, he is only in the eighth era after all, and he does not control the imperial law.
Without imperial law, the connection between the peak of the King of the Eighth Age and the great avenue of heaven and earth would be cut off!
It is impossible to completely kill the fourth divine general!
Behind the heavenly camp, the leaders of the vassal forces also had a glimmer of hope in their eyes.
As long as the fourth divine general does not die, Heaven will not be considered a complete loser!
The Divine Spear Emperor just looked at the fourth divine general quietly, with no trace of ripples in his eyes as calm as water.
He waited until the fourth divine general's laughter subsided before he spoke slowly.
